tasks.label: om: session start
tasks.detail: Inject vault context (North Star, active work, recent changes, open tasks, hygiene flags). Runs automatically on folder open — disable in Tasks: Manage Automatic Tasks if not wanted.

tasks.label: om: validate write
tasks.detail: Validate frontmatter and wikilinks after writing a .md file. Run this after Copilot creates or edits a note to catch missing required fields.

tasks.label: om: classify message
tasks.detail: Classify the current message and inject routing hints (decision, incident, win, 1:1, architecture, person, project update).

tasks.label: om: pre-compact
tasks.detail: Back up session transcript to thinking/session-logs/ before context compaction.

tasks.label: om: stop checklist
tasks.detail: End-of-session hygiene checklist: archive completed work, verify note quality, surface open loops.
